Package io.webagent4j.locator

Record Class LocatorDiagnostics

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.webagent4j.locator.LocatorDiagnostics
Record Components:
requestedLocator - immutable requested locator
resolutionPolicy - applied policy
diagnosticsLevel - retained detail level
scopePath - hierarchical scope path
strategiesExecuted - ordered strategy executions
strategiesSkipped - ordered skipped strategies
candidatesDiscovered - raw candidates reported by backends
candidatesDeduplicated - duplicate discoveries merged into existing candidates
candidatesRejected - candidates rejected by constraints or thresholds
filtersApplied - ordered hard constraints
exactMatches - accepted candidates with decisive exact evidence
fuzzyMatches - accepted candidates with fuzzy evidence
selectedCandidate - selected candidate when resolution succeeded
duration - total elapsed resolution time
budgetReached - whether one or more work limits were reached
reachedLimits - exact reached limits
ambiguity - ambiguity details when single() could not select safely
rejectedCandidates - bounded detailed rejection records
public record LocatorDiagnostics(LocatorDefinition requestedLocator, LocatorResolutionPolicy resolutionPolicy, LocatorDiagnosticsLevel diagnosticsLevel, List<String> scopePath, List<LocatorDiagnostics.StrategyExecution> strategiesExecuted, List<LocatorDiagnostics.SkippedStrategy> strategiesSkipped, int candidatesDiscovered, int candidatesDeduplicated, int candidatesRejected, List<String> filtersApplied, int exactMatches, int fuzzyMatches, Optional<LocatorCandidate> selectedCandidate, Duration duration, boolean budgetReached, Set<LocatorDiagnostics.BudgetLimit> reachedLimits, Optional<LocatorDiagnostics.Ambiguity> ambiguity, List<LocatorDiagnostics.RejectedCandidate> rejectedCandidates) extends Record
Immutable machine-readable resolution diagnostics. Detailed rejected-candidate data is bounded by the configured candidate budget and retained only in detailed mode.
